scope.priority: OLE2 and OOXML remain the active priority; ODF deferred; iWork excluded.

hypothesis.statement: ZipVerifier::read runs its completion branch on both the read that completes a member's payload and the terminating zero-length read that Read::read_to_end must observe, so a data-descriptor-framed entry resolves its descriptor twice from the source per verified read.
hypothesis.equivalence: The skipped resolution would compare the same CRC and size against the same immutable entry, so it can only reach the same conclusion. The memo is written only after a successful verification.
hypothesis.predicted_effect: one descriptor read per verified entry read; immediate back-to-back duplicate positional reads fall towards zero on descriptor-framed packages; distinct ranges and payload bytes unchanged.

acceptance.primary_gate: counted-read tests must show exactly one payload-bearing read at the descriptor offset and zero immediate duplicate ranges, and must fail without the change.
acceptance.secondary_gate: whole-child pread64 counts must fall with the distinct-range count unchanged.
acceptance.latency_gate: paired A/G/G/A p50 reported for the OOXML file-source selectors; any cell adverse in both directions by more than 5% is reported explicitly.

cpu.aslr: disabled with setarch -R for the selector matrix; CPU 21 for traces
